objective: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

description: In the snowy mountains of Winterspring, to the northwest, a skilled hunter stalks his prey... I speak of Ursius of the shardtooth bears, an agile and clever beast.
I send you now against him. He roams the sloping hills to the northwest of Everlook. Find and hunt him, before he discovers your intent.
All that have gone up against Ursius have quickly found themselves to be the prey, and he, the hunter. Stay on your guard.
completion: This was no easy task, yet you have excelled. But do not be too quick to think you have impressed me, <name>.
